package codestructuretype

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetCodeStructureType fetches structure type by id.
type GetCodeStructureType struct {
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle returns structure type by id.
func (uc GetCodeStructureType) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	return uc.Structures.Get(ctx, id)
}
